+def _metadata_values(values: str | list[str] | None) -> list[str]:
+    """Return metadata strings as a list, ignoring unsupported input types."""
+    if isinstance(values, str):
+        return [values]
+    if isinstance(values, list):
+        return values
+    return []
+
+
+def get_isbn_10_and_13(
+    isbns: str | list[str] | None,
+) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
+    """Normalize and separate ISBN-10 and ISBN-13 values by their format."""
+    isbn_10 = []
+    isbn_13 = []
+    for isbn in _metadata_values(isbns):
+        if not isinstance(isbn, str):
+            continue
+        isbn = isbn.strip()
+        if not isbn or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9Xx\s-]+", isbn):
+            continue
+
+        # IA metadata sometimes includes display separators. Open Library stores
+        # identifiers without spaces or hyphens.
+        normalized = re.sub(r"[\s-]", "", isbn).upper()
+        if (
+            len(normalized) == 10
+            and normalized[:9].isdigit()
+            and normalized[-1] in "0123456789X"
+        ):
+            isbn_10.append(normalized)
+        elif len(normalized) == 13 and normalized.isdigit():
+            isbn_13.append(normalized)
+    return isbn_10, isbn_13
+
+
+def get_publisher_and_place(
+    publishers: str | list[str] | None,
+) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
+    """Separate publisher names and publication places from IA metadata."""
+    publisher_names = []
+    publish_places = []
+    for value in _metadata_values(publishers):
+        if not isinstance(value, str):
+            continue
+        value = value.strip()
+        if not value:
+            continue
+
+        place, separator, publisher = value.partition(":")
+        if separator:
+            place = place.strip()
+            publisher = publisher.strip()
+            if place and publisher:
+                publish_places.append(place)
+                publisher_names.append(publisher)
+        else:
+            publisher_names.append(value)
+    return publisher_names, publish_places
+
